notes: transcode.sas defines the two PROC FCMP functions transcode() and cell_transcode() that every other macro in the toolkit depends on. Shipped verbatim. The caller exercises the UTF-8 code path with the exact example from docs/transcode.md (the NCR sequence 试验组 and its RTF-cell-escaped form \u35797;\u39564;\u32452;), both of which decode to 试验组 ("trial group", a real clinical-trial term) -- the toolkit's own documented example, unmodified.
